voice.consent_body:
Your browser converts speech to text. In Chrome and Edge this is done by the browser maker's online speech service, which receives the audio.
NyaySutra never receives or stores audio — only the text that appears in the question box, which you can edit before sending.
You can revoke this choice under Tools › Privacy.
consent.title: Send document text to the AI service?
consent.body:
This task sends the text of the selected document(s) to the configured language model service (Ollama Cloud). Identity numbers such as Aadhaar, PAN, phone and bank account numbers are masked first; names and facts are sent because the analysis needs them.
Only continue if you are authorised to share this client material with that service.

about.title: About NyaySutra AI
about.how_md:
1. **Plan** — a fast model classifies the request (research, drafting, document analysis, limitation, chat), rewrites it as a standalone English query and adds old/new-code equivalents (IPC↔BNS, CrPC↔BNSS, Evidence Act↔BSA).
2. **Retrieve** — four signals are fused with weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion: exact provision lookup (*Section 138 NI Act*), BM25 keyword search (SQLite FTS5), dense vectors (local embeddings) and an act-focused vector search.
3. **Rerank** — a cross-encoder scores each passage against the question; weak evidence triggers an automatic query rewrite, and if evidence is still weak the assistant declines instead of guessing.
4. **Generate** — the answer is written only from numbered sources and streamed live, in the language you choose.
5. **Audit** — every cited claim is checked against its source; unsupported points are flagged under the answer.
about.ocr_missing: Not installed — scanned files cannot be read (see README)
about.chunking_md:
- **Bare acts** — one passage per Section / Article / Order-Rule, tagged with act, chapter, number and title, so provisions can be retrieved exactly.
- **Judgments** — numbered paragraphs grouped into ~1,100-character passages with page numbers.
- **Contracts & pleadings** — numbered clauses grouped the same way.
- **Hindi / Marathi documents** — kept in the original script; an English translation (on request) is indexed alongside so English questions can find them.
about.security_md:
- **Accounts**: Supabase Auth (e-mail verification, password hashing, reset links, two-step verification). The browser holds only an HttpOnly session cookie; tokens stay on the server.
- **Roles**: Lawyer (anyone who registers) and Administrator (appointed by an administrator, never self-chosen). Each case lists the people who may open it; calendars and research history are private to each person.
- **Database rules** (row-level security) enforce the same access in Supabase Postgres; files are in a private bucket reached only through the server.
- Session cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict) + CSRF token + Host/Origin checks; idle and absolute session expiry; account lockout after repeated failures.
- Uploads: type allow-list, content signature check, active-content check (PDF JavaScript, Word macros), size limit, server-generated names.
- AI: requests are screened, documents are treated as data (instruction-like text is flagged), citations are checked against the sources, and identity numbers (Aadhaar, PAN, phone …) are masked before text is sent to the language model.
- Strict Content-Security-Policy, no third-party scripts; all rendered text is escaped.

lookup.lead: Find a matter using any identifiers you have — you don't need to fill every field.
lookup.honesty: Official court and police portals (eCourts, Supreme Court, Bombay High Court, police FIR portals) offer no public API and protect their search pages with a CAPTCHA. NyaySutra does not bypass that: it identifies the right portal and the exact values to enter, searches your own workspace, and lets you import what you find.

privacy.title: Privacy and data retention
privacy.intro_md: NyaySutra keeps your data only as long as it is useful to you, then deletes it automatically. The periods below apply to everyone; your administrator may set different ones for your organisation.
privacy.job_on: An automatic clean-up runs every day and permanently deletes data older than these periods.
privacy.job_off: The automatic clean-up is switched off on this installation.
privacy.where_md:
- **Database and files:** a private Supabase project in Mumbai (India). Each person sees only their own chats and history, and only the cases they are members of.
- **AI processing:** the text of a question and the passages used to answer it are sent to the configured AI model. Personal identifiers such as Aadhaar, PAN, phone numbers and e-mail addresses are replaced by placeholders first.
- **Web search:** only the search words are sent (client and party names removed), never your documents.
privacy.rights_md:
- Delete any chat, search, case or document yourself at any time; it is removed immediately.
- If your account has not been used for a long time you are warned in the app (and by e-mail, if e-mail is set up) before it is deleted; signing in once keeps it.
- For a copy or the deletion of your data, contact your administrator.
